sentences.text: The variation printed in the rose applies to the year shown, so update it.
Suppose the rose says fourteen degrees forty-five minutes west in twenty ten, increasing two minutes a year.
In twenty twenty-six, sixteen years have passed.
Sixteen times two minutes is thirty-two minutes of increase.
Fourteen forty-five plus thirty-two minutes is fifteen degrees seventeen minutes west, or about fifteen degrees west.
Note that many exam questions simply give you the variation to use, so read the question carefully before doing this step.
